Hi Sarah / Stephanie — quick debug notes from the invite snapshot:

What I see: the original event had a Zoom join URL in an ATTACH: or X-ALT-URL field that some calendar systems hide when the invite is forwarded. Forwarding can cause the organizer: header to be treated as a forwarded text blob which makes the client drop the join metadata.

Recommended immediate steps (minimal risk):
- Option A (fast): Use Stephanie's temporary Zoom link above and paste into the event description. Works for everyone immediately.
- Option B (corrective, medium effort): Regenerate the .ics from our side with explicit organizer claim and host-key rotation. Process: rotate host key, regenerate ICS, send a canary invite to a single Veridian attendee, confirm join URL stays present after forward, then reissue to all attendees.

I can execute Option B if you want the persistent fix. It typically takes 20–30 minutes, and I'll run a canary test before broad resend.

Log snippet: organizer: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Join URL field present in original but placed in X-ALT-URL; client-forwarding removed the X-ALT-URL on your side.

If you want me to rotate the host-key and re-issue, say the word and I will do the canary test to the ops address first (ops@veridianbio.com).

— Ben Carter
